part_number.product: SEL-700G Generator / Intertie / Wind Generator Protection Relay
part_number.note: 20-digit MOT string. Positions 9-10, 11-12, 13-14 and 15-16 are anchored by the drawing layers (SLOT_C=9, SLOT_D=11, SLOT_E=13, SLOT_Z=15). Layer-anchor correction: the drawing's COMBINED_SLOT_B group carries source.position=7, but real part numbers show positions 7-8 are the Slot A power-supply and Slot A digital-input voltages, and the Slot B Ethernet/rear-serial digit actually lives at position 18 (single digit, not a 2-digit slot). Position 6 (model variant) does not distinguish the '+' Auto-Synchronizer options (700G0 vs 700G0+, 700G1 vs 700G1+, 700GT vs 700GT+) - both share the same code. Slot E (13-14) can hold an I/O card (2nd digit = DI voltage) OR an AC current/voltage/Vsync card (7x) OR a Rogowski/LPCT/LEA card (Lx) whose 2nd digit selects the ACI/AVI configuration.
references: SEL-700G-0, -1, -T, -W Generator and Intertie Protection Relay Ordering Information (WI-8147, 20241021)
SEL-700G master configuration drawings i7358.B / i7363.B etc. (drawing layers)

example_part_numbers.note: Real PN (IM): 700G1, 110-250V PS / 125V DI, Slot C 4DI/4DO FHCH @125V, Slot D 10 RTD, Slot E 76 (3-Ph 5A ACI+Vsync+Vn, 3 ACI/2 AVI), Slot Z 85 (5A/5A + 3-Ph V), Eng LCD, Dual 100Base-FX Eth, IEC 61850+DNP3, no conformal coat

Real PN (IM): 700GT, 110-250V PS / 125V DI, Slot C 4DI/4DO EM @125V, Slot D 8DO, Slot E 75 (3-Ph 5A ACI + 3-Ph V + Vsync, 3 ACI/4 AVI), Slot Z 85, Eng LCD, Dual 10/100Base-T Eth, IEC 61850+DNP3, no conformal coat

Real PN (IM): 700GW, 110-250V PS / 125V DI, Slot C 4DI/4DO EM @125V, Slot D 4AI/4AO, Slot E 77 (3-Ph 5A ACIE), Slot Z 87 (3-Ph 5A ACIZ), Eng LCD, Single 10/100Base-T EIA-485 Eth, IEC 61850, no conformal coat

positions.label: Model / Protection Package
positions.note: The '+' Auto-Synchronizer variants share the base code and cannot be distinguished from the part number.

options.0: 700G0 / 700G0+ (Basic Generator Protection: 87N, REF, 49T, 50/51G, 51V/C, 46, BF, 27/59, 24, 64F, 67G/N, 32, 40, 60LOP, 81/81R; '+' adds Gen 25, 64G, 21, 78, 78VS, Auto Synchronizer)
options.1: 700G1 / 700G1+ (Basic Generator Protection plus 87, 21, 78, 78VS; '+' adds Gen 25, 64G, Auto Synchronizer)
options.T: 700GT / 700GT+ (Intertie Protection: 50/51, BF, 67P/Q/G, Tie 25, 27/59, 32, 60LOP, 81/81R; '+' adds Basic Generator plus Auto Synchronizer)

positions.label: Slot C card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Digital input voltage (letters) or None (X/0). Serial Communications card is Slot C only. Only one 3 DI/4 DO/1 AO and one 4 AI/4 AO card per chassis.

options.6: 4 AI / 4 AO (±20 mA or ±10 V Range)
options.C: 4 DI / 4 DO Fast High Current Hybrid (Form A)
options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

positions.label: Slot D card | DI voltage
positions.note: First digit = card type, second digit = Digital input voltage (letters) or None (X/0). The 10 RTD card (9) is Slot D only.

options.6: 4 AI / 4 AO (±20 mA or ±10 V Range)
options.C: 4 DI / 4 DO Fast High Current Hybrid (Form A)
options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)

positions.label: Slot E card | DI voltage / AC-input config
positions.note: First digit = card type. For I/O cards the second digit is the DI voltage (letters) or None (X/0). Card 7 = AC current/voltage/Vsync card and card L = Rogowski/LPCT/LEA card; for those the numeric second digit selects the ACI/AVI configuration.

options.6: 4 AI / 4 AO (±20 mA or ±10 V Range)
options.7: AC Current / Voltage / Vsync input card
options.C: 4 DI / 4 DO Fast High Current Hybrid (Form A)
options.D: 4 DI / 3 DO Electromechanical (2 Form C, 1 Form B)
options.L: Rogowski Coil / Low-Power CT or LEA Voltage input card

components.label: Digital input voltage or AC-input configuration

options.1: AC card: 3-Ph 1 A ACI + 3-Ph AC Voltage 300 Vac + Vsync (SELECT 3 ACI / 4 AVI); L card: 3-Ph Rogowski/LPCT + 3-Ph & Vsync LEA (SELECT 3 ACI / 4 AVI)
options.2: AC card: 3-Ph 1 A ACI + Vsync + Vn 300 Vac (SELECT 3 ACI / 2 AVI); L card: 3-Ph Rogowski/LPCT + 1-N & Vsync LEA (SELECT 3 ACI / 2 AVI)
options.3: AC card: 3-Ph 1 A ACI (SELECT 3 ACIE, 700G1/700GW only); L card: 3-Ph Rogowski/LPCT (SELECT 3 ACI, 700G1/700GW only)
options.4: AC card: Vsync + Vn 300 Vac (SELECT 2 AVI); L card: 1-N & Vsync LEA (SELECT 2 AVI)
options.5: AC card: 3-Ph 5 A ACI + 3-Ph AC Voltage 300 Vac + Vsync (SELECT 3 ACI / 4 AVI)
options.6: AC card: 3-Ph 5 A ACI + Vsync + Vn 300 Vac (SELECT 3 ACI / 2 AVI)
options.7: AC card: 3-Ph 5 A ACI (SELECT 3 ACIE, 700G1/700GW only)

positions.label: Slot Z Current and Voltage Inputs
positions.note: Base-unit current/voltage input. 8x = AC current inputs (with 3-phase AC voltage on 81/82/85/86), Lx = Rogowski/LPCT/LEA. Availability depends on the model variant (position 6).

options.81: 3-Ph 1 A ACI / 1 A Neutral ACI / 3-Ph AC Voltage 300 Vac (SELECT 4 ACI / 3 AVI) [700G0/G0+/G1/G1+/GT+]
options.82: 3-Ph 1 A ACI / 5 A Neutral ACI / 3-Ph AC Voltage 300 Vac (SELECT 4 ACI / 3 AVI) [700G0/G0+/G1/G1+/GT+]
options.85: 3-Ph 5 A ACI / 5 A Neutral ACI / 3-Ph AC Voltage 300 Vac (SELECT 4 ACI / 3 AVI) [700G0/G0+/G1/G1+/GT+]
options.86: 3-Ph 5 A ACI / 1 A Neutral ACI / 3-Ph AC Voltage 300 Vac (SELECT 4 ACI / 3 AVI) [700G0/G0+/G1/G1+/GT+]
options.L1: 3-Ph / 1-Neutral Rogowski or LPCT + 3-Ph LEA Voltage Sensor (SELECT 4 ACI / 3 AVI) [700G0/G0+/G1/G1+/GT+]

positions.label: Slot B Ethernet (Port 1) | Rear Serial (Port 3)
positions.note: Descriptions also appear in the drawing COMBINED_SLOT_B layer, but that layer's source.position=7 does not match the MOT: the Ethernet/rear-serial digit is a single digit at position 18. EIA-485 rear is available only with No Ethernet or Single 10/100Base-T.

positions.label: Protocols
positions.note: IEC 61850 and EtherNet/IP are available only on models with an Ethernet option in Slot B.

positions.label: Conformal Coat
positions.note: Some Instruction-Manual example part numbers carry an 'X' placeholder in this position instead of 0/1.
